scoring_justification: Cannot recompute U and voltages from raw DFT outputs; lightweight verifier compares agent's reported numbers to paper gold within tolerances that accommodate toolchain spread while excluding random guesses.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold Hubbard U values (eV) from Table II
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted exactly from Table II; includes monoxide reference values for completeness but those are not required to be produced by the agent.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All values are the paper's own reported numbers; no random fabrication.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold lithium intercalation voltages (V) from GGA+U calculations
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text and Figures 4-5; voltage values reported in the paper: 4.1, 3.47, 4.73, 5.07, 3.82, 3.92, 4.19, 2.97, 3.56 V
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's GGA+U results (large filled circles / averaged U values); matched to the reference solve.sh constants.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Taken directly from the paper's reported computational results; not invented.

schema.description: Self-consistent Hubbard U parameters (eV) for each TM ion/valence/environment combination listed in the paper's Table II.

outputs.description: JSON dictionary of self-consistent Hubbard U values (eV). Keys like "Mn2+_olivine", values are floats.
CSV table of average lithium intercalation voltages for all redox couples, including optional experimental reference. Scoring uses the computed_voltage column.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the agent's computed U values and voltages to the paper-reported gold values within hidden tolerances. Voltage comparison uses the paper's GGA+U calculated values and/or experimental voltages; the agent must produce all entries from the paper's full dataset.

trend_rules.description: U increases with oxidation state (except Ni layered, already known)
Olivine U > oxide U for same valence (Mn3+, Co3+, Ni3+ where both exist)
